label: Inclination following an intelligible form presenting a good counts as HAS_WILL_1
paraphrase: Open analyst premise. If a GOD_4 bearer apprehends something as good under an intelligible form and has an inclination following that same form, it HAS_WILL_1. The recognition is substantive: the inclination must be toward the good under the apprehended aspect. The proposition uses the primitive possession predicate and does not posit a separate passive faculty or an actual episode.
